name: metr_point_v0_graphzero_head202
rationale: Combine two independently inspected mechanisms: reduce unsupported random graph mixing and suppress the rare negative GELU tail of output neuron 202. The graph-half trial improved MAE with a small MSE tradeoff; sharpening neuron 202 improved MSE and slightly MAE. This paired calibration evaluation tests their interaction before any confirmation or test selection.
